name: aceva-crm
description: Aceva Digital System: monorepo (frontend, backend, shared contracts)

scripts.typecheck: npm run build:contracts && npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w aceva-digital-system-web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w aceva-digital-system-web
scripts.test: npm run build:contracts && npm run test -w @aceva/contracts && npm run test -w backend
scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w aceva-digital-system-web
